settings.editor: How Onyx Research gathers, uses, keeps, discloses and protects your personal data, in line with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR.
Last updated: 9 July 2026

At Onyx Research Ltd, protecting your personal information is something we take seriously. This Privacy Policy describes the way Onyx Research Ltd ("Onyx Research", "we", "us" or "our") gathers, uses, keeps, discloses and protects your personal data, and we follow the standards set by the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) and every other UK data protection law that applies to us.
Onyx Research is a company incorporated in England and Wales. Our registered office is in the United Kingdom.
Whether you are a customer, a casual visitor to our site, an account holder, a business buyer or simply someone making an enquiry, this Policy explains how we treat the information we hold about you.
When you browse our website or buy from us, you confirm that you understand and accept the way we handle personal data as described here.
This Policy covers the personal data we handle across each of the following:
contact by email, phone or any other electronic channel;
orders you place for Onyx Research products;
any eligibility or compliance checks we carry out, where these apply.
It does not extend to our employees, contractors or outside service providers, whose information is dealt with under separate arrangements.
When we say "Personal Data", we mean any information that points to a particular living person, either on its own or when combined with other details we hold.
"Processing" refers to anything we do with that data, from collecting and storing it through to using, sharing or otherwise working with it.
"Customer" is used broadly and covers everyday consumers as well as wellness practitioners, clinics and business purchasers.

settings.title: Categories of Personal Data We Collect

settings.editor: Identity data: such as your full name, date of birth or age, title, and business or practitioner details where relevant.
Contact data: billing and delivery addresses, email address and telephone numbers.
Technical data: IP address, device identifiers, browser and session information, cookies and analytics data.
Transaction data: order history, payment confirmations, products purchased and invoicing details.

Eligibility and verification data: declarations confirming you are 21 or over and that products are purchased for personal adult wellness use, together with any supporting documents you choose to provide.
Communications data: emails, support requests and other messages you send to us.
We do not store full payment card details; payments are handled securely by regulated third-party processors.
Directly from you: when you place an order, create an account, complete a form, contact customer support or submit an eligibility declaration.
Automatically: through cookies and analytics tools that gather technical data as you browse the site.
From third parties: such as payment processors, courier systems and, where applicable, identity verification providers.
Contractual necessity: where processing is needed to fulfil your order or provide our services.
Legal obligation: for tax, accounting, fraud prevention and regulatory compliance.
Legitimate interests: where processing is reasonably necessary to:
maintain product safety, including for temperature-sensitive cold-chain items;
Consent: for marketing communications, which you may withdraw at any time.
Only individuals aged 21 or over may purchase Onyx Research products.
We may request proof of age where necessary to satisfy our compliance obligations.
To process and deliver your orders, including dispatch logistics and related communications.
To manage customer accounts and order history.
To send safety, temperature-handling and regulatory notifications.
To prevent fraud and misuse of our products.
To comply with accounting, tax, legal and regulatory requirements.
To improve the functionality and security of our website.
We may share personal data with the following regulated or contractually bound parties:
courier companies, for delivery and dispatch updates;
legal, tax and regulatory authorities, where required by law;
professional advisers, such as lawyers and accountants.
Onyx Research does not sell personal data under any circumstances.
We may transfer data outside the UK where our hosting or service providers require it.
Where we do, we ensure compliance using Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK Addendum or recognised adequacy decisions.
We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for lawful purposes:
order and tax records: a minimum of 6 years;
eligibility and compliance declarations: a minimum of 7 years;
account data: until your account is closed;
We implement industry-standard technical and organisational measures, including restricted access, encryption, anti-malware protections and secure backups.
Despite these precautions, no transmission or storage of data can be guaranteed entirely secure.
Under UK GDPR you have the right to:
lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).
To make a request, please contact us by email at sales@onyxhealth.net.
Our website uses both essential and analytical cookies.
Full details are set out in our Cookies Policy.
This Privacy Policy should be read together with our:
We may update this Policy at any time.
The latest version will always be published on our website.
For questions about this policy, please contact Onyx Research Ltd.
